text: The displayed retry removes the huge rear spray and reduces mottling, retaining Neris’s counter and the toad’s recoil.

The shield repair FAILED: the grip remains on the creature/contact side while her arm approaches from the other side. The crescent is narrower and the arm more exposed. Selected for texture relief only; construction and action are not accepted.

feedback.text: These are all absolutely amazing. Do another round (include any/all refinements and miprovements and recommendations) at your discretion. The only complaint I have is that these started to trend more back into too busy, hurting eyes, way too many and too busy textures. so maybe consider a way to keep or improve most of whats there while simplifying the textures (the very busy textures is a big ai tell givewaway and lands in the uncanny valley). I want you to keep iterating towards my vision, please try to wow and impress me (me personally baesd on what you know of my style and taste and goal).
